---
title: Gate reports
toc-depth: 2
---

Each phase ends with a gate. The reviewer runs `make gate PHASE=N`, checks every acceptance criterion and invariant, and writes a report. The reports below are the evidence that a phase is done, including what failed and what was fixed.

::: {.source-note}
The reports are the files in [`docs/gates/`]({{< meta source-repo >}}/tree/main/docs/gates). A new report appears here when it is added to that folder.
:::

::: {fragments="_generated/gates.txt" wrap="demote" empty="No gate report has been written yet."}
:::
